title: Engineering Summit
summaryLead: A marketing site that explains a Shopify planning product in seconds.
summaryMore: Framework-free HTML and CSS, with the grain, score ring and fluid type all done in CSS.

stack.name: Scope
stack.detail: This covers the framework-free landing site. The Summit app itself runs on Next.js and Supabase.

stack.name: Styling
stack.detail: Hand-written CSS with design tokens, Grid and clamp().

stack.name: Type
stack.detail: Newsreader, Manrope and DM Mono from Google Fonts.

stack.name: Grain
stack.detail: An SVG feTurbulence filter as a data URI. No image request.

stack.name: Score ring
stack.detail: A CSS conic-gradient with a centred pseudo-element. No chart library.

chapters.title: Paper grain with no image
chapters.challenge: Add tactile texture without extra requests.
chapters.solution: An SVG noise filter as a data URI on a fixed layer.
chapters.outcome: Zero extra requests and sharp on any screen.

chapters.title: A score ring in pure CSS
chapters.challenge: Show a data-rich score card without Chart.js or D3.
chapters.solution: A conic-gradient donut with a centred pseudo-element.
chapters.outcome: A crisp ring with no runtime dependency.

chapters.title: Fluid headline type
chapters.challenge: Big headlines with no layout shift or breakpoint overrides.
chapters.outcome: Headlines scale smoothly from phone to desktop.

results.title: Speed
results.text: A static page with no framework runtime.

results.title: Maintainability
results.text: One set of CSS variables controls the design.

results.title: Resilience
results.text: Few dependencies, so little to maintain.
